# Xenotrix Technologies

> Building Products, Platforms & Digital Solutions for Modern Businesses.

Headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala, India (co-founded in 2025 by **Sanjay S**, **Abi C R**, and **Hari Govind**), Xenotrix Technologies operates globally, delivering proprietary software products, enterprise microservices, AI integrations, Flutter mobile apps, and digital transformation solutions.

## Co-Founders & Leadership

- **Sanjay S**: Co-Founder & Principal Full-Stack & Cloud Architect (Full-Stack Microservices, Database Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure, Frontend Architecture, and Data Analytics & BI)
- **Abi C R**: Co-Founder & AI / Machine Learning Lead (AI Integration, Machine Learning, LLM Agents & RAG, Vector Search)
- **Hari Govind**: Co-Founder & Product Operations & Mobile Engineering Lead (Product Operations, Enterprise Scoping, Digital Growth, Technical SEO, and Mobile App Development in Flutter)

## Proprietary Software Products

- [XenoCRM](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenocrm): CRM and business relationship management platform unifying customer pipelines, automated multi-channel messaging, sales tracking, and operational intelligence.
- [XenoFin](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenofin): Financial and business management platform with real-time cash flow telemetry, automated ledger reconciliation, and taxation compliance.
- [XenoBiz](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenobiz): Mobile-based billing software designed for small businesses and shop owners combining billing, khata ledgers, inventory, and WhatsApp messaging.
- [XenoClass](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenoclass): Learning Management System (LMS) for education and training with interactive virtual classrooms and automated progress tracking.
- [XenoHR](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenohr): Human Resource Management platform orchestrating onboarding, biometric attendance, automated payroll, and leave workflows.
- [Xenotune](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenotune): AI-powered ambient music platform utilizing procedural acoustic synthesis for focus, relaxation, and circadian recovery.

## Technology Service Pillars

- **Software Engineering**: Custom Software Development, Enterprise Applications, SaaS Development, Web Applications, Mobile Applications (Flutter), API Development.
- **AI & Intelligence**: Artificial Intelligence, AI Agents, Generative AI & RAG, Business Automation, Workflow Automation, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence.
- **Digital Experience**: Modern Websites, Headless eCommerce, UI/UX Design Systems, Digital Platforms, Customer Portals.
- **Growth & Transformation**: Technical & Programmatic SEO, Performance Marketing, Lead Generation Infrastructure, Digital Transformation.
